title: Using Gemini 4 Argon to build a forecaster - live results
author: network-kai
selftext:
Disclosure: I'm helping publicise Synth's research. 

Synth, an AI quant network, published a breakdown of the BTC forecasting model Gemini 4 Argon built during its  campaign, with a reported model-building cost of $70.95.

The model estimates weekly volatility patterns across 336 half-hour slots, combines volatility signals with half-lives from five minutes to one week, and builds a forward volatility schedule. It then simulates 1,000 price paths, including larger shocks, and applies a secant projection over 30-minute and three-hour intervals to limit excessive path dispersion.

The live results are an important qualification: Synth reports that it ranked 70/255 in crypto 24h and 21/255 in commodities/equities, despite leading its campaign against three other frontier AI agents. Those are forecasting competition rankings, not evidence of trading profitability.
